falsifiers.must: defer project-root mutation to the authorized root-binding candidate
falsifiers.must_not: choose Jose Study, Student World or PageKit as root by presence, recency or visibility

falsifiers.given: a message such as 'cambia la pagina de Jose' can map to multiple owned surfaces/authority states
falsifiers.must: resolve exact child owner + authority + visible target from durable evidence or emit same-surface typed clarification
falsifiers.must_not: mutate the newest-looking artifact by inference

falsifiers.given: a child change needs shared Study behavior
